requirement.statement: The system SHALL implement OpenAI official Chat Completions and DeepSeek official Chat Completions as two explicit effect bundles composed with one shared Chat Completions core; provider selection MUST come from the configured driver and MUST NOT be inferred from model or URL strings.

case.given: the configured provider driver is OpenAI Chat Completions
case.when: a request and stream are processed
case.then: the OpenAI official effect bundle SHALL be used
DeepSeek-only reasoning compatibility fields MUST NOT be injected

case.given: the configured provider driver is DeepSeek
case.when: a request and stream are processed against an official or explicitly configured compatible endpoint
case.then: the DeepSeek official effect bundle SHALL be used independently of model and Base URL naming
DeepSeek reasoning continuation SHALL remain protocol-correct

case.given: OpenAI and DeepSeek streams use Chat Completions delta framing
case.when: content and tool-call deltas are reduced
case.then: both bundles SHALL reuse the same pure stream core
content, tool-call and ingress event behavior SHALL remain compatible with the existing adapter

case.given: a provider driver has been selected for the current request
case.when: the response stream is passed through executor, terminal runtime and ingress reduction
case.then: the same driver bundle binding SHALL control request and stream semantics
the stream path MUST NOT reselect a provider bundle from adapter type, model or Base URL strings

case.given: Chat Completions reduction interprets provider reasoning and tool-call protocol fields
case.when: the shared core and official bundles are packaged
case.then: their contracts and logic SHALL reside in AI domain contract and logic packages
the symbiont layer MUST remain limited to provider-neutral stream and runtime primitives

case.given: the configured provider uses OpenAI Responses API
case.then: the Responses driver and continuation model SHALL remain outside the Chat Completions effect bundles
any reuse of normalized ingress reduction MUST NOT invoke OpenAI Chat request, endpoint or history projection
